name: Durnek Ashmantle
source_profile:
Overseer Durnek Ashmantle (LE) is the Consortium's principal mine superintendent, notorious

for his brutal management of labor and relentless pursuit of production quotas. He considers the illithid tribute an unfortunate but manageable cost of doing business and has little interest in challenging the existing order.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 79 (source excerpt; may be partial)
